method: One normal CLI run over the85 whole byte-identical fixture files;536case IDs checked exactly, with no --matching filter, no disabled cases, no substitutions or fitted inputs. Explicit manifest corpus selection excludes the separate external inbox.
winnerMetric: Correct observed winner classifications, not independent raw server winner fields. New reverse Infantry004 has both recorded survivor totals zero; its corrected defender winner is independently supported by report UI. The historical survivor-derived draw is preserved separately, not silently overwritten.
rawWinnerEvidenceInNewTen: No independent winner field in either five-report raw combat payload. Infantry004 winner uses separately verified report UI; historical survivor-derived draw remains provenance.

winnerEvidence.source: independently-bound-in-game-UI
winnerEvidence.bindingMethod: Independent report time, location, side roles, troop counts and casualties matched privately. Private identities and location omitted here.
winnerEvidence.verification: Root independently reviewed full attacker-view UI; original defender-view victory also corroborated by its collecting controller. This exporter verifies both native hashes and the signed-off binding; it does not claim a new visual inspection.
winnerEvidence.limitation: Rounded survivor totals do not establish the game-declared winner. No winner field exists in the decoded combat payload.
